purpose: Frozen stability observation protocol. The observation gate becomes an archive gate only when run against the release candidate fixed by this manifest.
releaseRevision: the exact commit SHA frozen by R5A desktop/visual/platform evidence; observation MUST run on that same build

logCompleteness.continuous: application logs must be continuous across the observation window with no gaps exceeding 1 minute
logCompleteness.forbiddenMarkers: no error/panic/stale-marker/session-leak/wrong-result-routing log markers during the window
logCompleteness.noDocumentContent: logs must never contain document content or secrets
logCompleteness.retention: logs archived per session; the app retention window is 7 days and is not extended for observation

evidenceRequired: per platform per workflow >= 3 successful runs recorded as observation evidence entries with start/end timestamps and log excerpts
